files.changes: One shell-wide hint layer; cold delay then instant while warm; focus shows at once and Escape closes; lean/travel springs, blur layers, long-press, arming fuse and colour props removed together with the Motion dependency; text is only the caller's static label; block variant for full-width list buttons. See README.md.
Semantic theme tokens only; no arrow (viewport clamping can make it point away from its trigger), no motion springs; reduced motion keeps the fade and drops the offset. See README.md.

Fully controlled, so a click can never look on before the real permission result arrives; the ring is a counted receipt played by CSS keyframes; the badge shows only the real unread count; sonar waves, clapper, spring reveal, count wobble, size/colour props and the Motion/Hugeicons dependencies removed; the bell glyph is the upstream inline path. See README.md.
Pill face driven by data-on with semantic tokens; label crossfade instead of a measured clip; one ring keyframe; reduced motion removes the ring animation. See README.md.

Maps one store item and owns the real countdown, so hover, focus, page-hidden and mid-drag can pause it; four dismissal paths (swipe, Escape, close button, real deadline); action slot, inline mode, spring settle and the Motion/Hugeicons dependencies removed; offsets go through a CSS variable instead of Motion values. See README.md.

Close button and fuse only: the card face and its presence rules stay in styles/global.css (#273 contract); the fuse length comes from the component's real remaining window; reduced motion stops the fuse animation while the timer still expires. See README.md.
Controlled application presentation; semantic theme and motion tokens; timers, guessed progress, retry, strike and external icon/Motion dependencies removed. See README.md.
